messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-api-us-west GPU pool exhaustion detected. queue_length=30212, p95_latency=2.8s, p99_latency=14.6s. autoscaler state=ERROR (quota_rejected). Paging oncall @Anna.
Anna (oncall): seeing it. joining. any customers impacted?
Maya (support): multiple 504s reported from a key customer (AcmeCorp). CS already alerted.
Eli (eng-sre): looks like autoscaler got 403 from cloud provider when requesting new VM instances: 
```
ERROR: quotaExceeded: "Insufficient GPUs available in region us-west2"
Request ID: req-03a6b4
```
So autoscaler is retrying but not succeeding. Queue growing fast.
Kim (infra): cloud console shows no quota shortage for project but region inventory says depleted for our GPU SKU. I've opened a support ticket with cloud (case 987654321). ETA unknown.
Anna (oncall): short term mitigations: 1) enable per-customer throttles to reduce tail load 2) route non-critical models to 'cpu-fallback' 3) enable quantized small model fallback for burst traffic. I'll coordinate.
Jake (devex): to enable throttles run: 
```
adminctl feature toggle throttle-per-customer --enable --threshold=200
```
I can flip that now if Anna gives go.
Anna (oncall): flip it.  :thumbsup:
Jake (devex): done. confirmed throttles applied. current per-customer inflight cap=200.
Eli (eng-sre): adding a fallback route to redwood-lite-v2-q8 for non-critical traffic. patching routing rule: 
```
PATCH /routing/policies/hosted/us-west
body: { "fallback_model":"redwood-lite-v2-q8", "eligibility":"non-critical" }
```
Deployed.
Liam (customer-success): letting AcmeCorp know we throttled to protect platform; sending note now.
Maya (support): backlog still climbing: 27k -> 31k in 6m after throttle. p99 still >12s. Some streaming sessions stuck in OPEN state.
Eli (eng-sre): identify and kill the largest long-running sessions: 
```
SELECT session_id, duration, model FROM open_sessions WHERE duration>45s ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 50;
# then
adminctl sessions terminate <session_id>
```
I've terminated 28 sessions that were stuck in OPEN with long KV cache usage. freed up some concurrency.
Anna (oncall): can we spin up reserved pool in another region and route traffic there?
Kim (infra): we have a dedicated reserved pool 'res-pool-burst' in us-east1 with capacity. We can temporarily failover traffic there but need to update routing + inform customers about cross-region latency.
Eli (eng-sre): enabling cross-region fallback policy: 
```
adminctl routing promote-region us-east1 for capacity=burst --max-redirect=30%
```
Applying now.
Jake (devex): also enabling model-quantization hinting to reduce per-token GPU time for heavy customers: feature flag on.
Anna (oncall): impacts: p95 down from 2.8s to 1.2s after throttles+session kills, p99 from 14.6s to ~6.3s. queue down to 12k but still high.
Maya (support): AcmeCorp updated: they saw improved request success rate (~70% now) but are still seeing some timeouts. CS wants status page update.
Anna (oncall): I'll draft status page.
Anna (oncall): status page note: 
"We are experiencing a GPU capacity shortage in us-west region causing elevated latencies and intermittent timeouts for the Hosted API. We have applied rate-limits, routed non-critical traffic to a quantized fallback model, and killed long-running sessions to stabilize the platform. We are failing over a portion of traffic to a reserved pool in us-east. Engineering and Infra are engaged with the cloud provider. Next update in 30 minutes."
Eli (eng-sre): cloud support responded: estimated replenishment 45-90m but not guaranteed. They recommended using alternate SKUs available in us-west but that requires model binary compatibility checks.
Kim (infra): we attempted to request alternate SKU (a100 -> a10x variant) but runtime needs small patch; CI builds for the variant are failing due to kernel mismatch. We're doing a binary fallback build, ETA 40m.
Anna (oncall): operational tasks: 
- Eli: monitor queue and p99 continuously and coordinate failover increments (10% steps).
- Kim: pursue cloud ticket + try alternate SKU patch.
- Jake: keep throttles and model routing in place; prepare rollback plan.
- Maya & Liam: update AcmeCorp + broader customer comms.
Everyone ack.
Eli (eng-sre): ack. set up an automated check: 
```
watch -n 10 'curl -s http://internal/metrics/hosted/us-west | jq .{queue,p95,p99}'
```
Posting alerts to #eng-sre if queue>15k.
Kim (infra): ack. cloud ticket updated with our mitigation steps. they've escalated to inventory team.
Jake (devex): note — we also enabled a temporary token-based per-minute throttle: 
```
adminctl quota set per_token_per_minute=60 --apply
```
This will help noisy clients.
Anna (oncall): timeline so far: 
T+0m: incident-bot alert (queue 30k).
T+3m: throttles on, routing fallback applied.
T+9m: session kills freed concurrency.
T+15m: cross-region failover 10% started.
T+22m: p95/p99 improved but queue still high.
T+30m: building alternate-SKU runtime (in progress).
Anna (oncall): if cloud replenishes GPUs before alternate SKU ready, we'll scale back cross-region failover and restore normal routing.
Maya (support): AcmeCorp acknowledged and prefers reduced latency over regional locality. asking for timeline. I gave 45-90m estimate.
Liam (customer-success): I'll flag top 5 enterprise customers for 1:1 outreach.
Eli (eng-sre): quick note: we added a temporary circuit-breaker for model streaming calls to 10s to shorten stuck tail latency. watch for increased 429s, those are intentional to shed load.
Jake (devex): 429s are showing up as expected (approx 0.8% of requests).
Anna (oncall): escalation path: if queue >25k after 60m, we will trigger exec oncall and open an incident bridge. For now continue mitigation.
Eli (eng-sre): logging snippet from autoscaler loop: 
```
[autoscaler] attempt=12 region=us-west sku=gpu-a100 status=403 body="quotaExceeded"
retry_after=30s
```
Kim (infra): cloud support ID 987654321 updated: inventory team says replenishment earliest in 50m. They recommended spinning up in alternate region which we've done.
Anna (oncall): thanks team. I'll keep this thread as the source of truth. Next update in 20m or on major state change. :white_check_mark:
